lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Honey, have you seen the TV? It's near our place.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, the whole area is crawling with soldiers. What a mess.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Really? This is all a bit unsettling...

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But they haven't told us to take shelter or anything.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, don't go outside, just to be safe.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I won't. I'll stay home and tuck into a good book.
